name: social-agent
description: Agente de marketing en redes sociales: ingiere ideas y media, genera contenido por plataforma con un agente experto LLM, y publica automáticamente en varios canales.

scripts.ingest: npm run build && node dist/cli.js ingest
scripts.generate: npm run build && node dist/cli.js generate
scripts.publish: npm run build && node dist/cli.js publish
scripts.serve: npm run build && node dist/cli.js serve
scripts.media:urls: npm run build && node dist/cli.js media-urls
scripts.metrics: npm run build && node dist/cli.js metrics
scripts.calendar: npm run build && node dist/cli.js calendar
scripts.calendar:md: npm run build && node dist/cli.js calendar --md
scripts.report: npm run build && node dist/cli.js report
scripts.plan: npm run build && node dist/cli.js plan
scripts.gen-image: npm run build && node dist/cli.js gen-image
scripts.panel: npm run build && node dist/cli.js panel
scripts.status: npm run build && node dist/cli.js status
